summary:
Task T1.1 completed in full. Two artefacts were produced and verified:

**docs/architecture_spec.md** — 229-line Markdown document covering:
- Full layer-by-layer architecture (Block1: Conv2d(1→32,3×3,pad=1)+ReLU+MaxPool(2); Block2: Conv2d(32→64,3×3,pad=1)+ReLU+MaxPool(2); Flatten 3136; FC(3136→256)+ReLU+Dropout(0.25); FC(256→10))
- Per-layer parameter breakdown: Conv1=320, Conv2=18,496, FC1=803,072, FC2=2,570 → total **824,458**
- Optimizer: Adam lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4, batch_size=64
- Train augmentation: RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5)+RandomCrop(28,pad=3)+RandomRotation(10°); val/test: ToTensor+Normalize(0.2860,0.3530)
- Design rationale: no BatchNorm (preserves underfitting signal), Dropout(0.25) in FC only, capacity calibrated so training accuracy ≲ 85 % at epoch 5

**src/train.py** — 270-line PyTorch training script with:
- argparse flags: --seed, --augment, --epochs, --data_dir, --out_dir
- Full seed fixation (torch, torch.cuda, numpy, random, cudnn deterministic)
- SmallCNN class exactly matching the spec (no BatchNorm anywhere; Dropout(0.25) after FC1 ReLU only)
- 50k/10k deterministic train/val split; augmentation applied to train only
- Per-epoch metrics.csv logger (epoch, train_loss, train_acc, val_loss, val_acc)
- Checkpoint saving at epochs 5, 10, 20, 30

CPU smoke tests confirmed: 2-epoch run produced correct CSV; 5-epoch run saved checkpoint_ep05.pt which reloads cleanly; forward pass produces (N,10) logits; epoch-1 train_acc=0.734 confirming underfitting regime.
